generations.name: C40 Recharge launch
generations.notes: Coupe-roof sibling of the XC40 Recharge on CMA, sold as C40 Recharge from MY2022 (Twin Motor AWD only in our regulator rows for 2022-2023): 78 kWh gross (~75 usable), DC up to 150 kW. Mirrors volvo/ex40's generations (same hardware). Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Volvo_EX40 ; https://www.carscoops.com/2023/05/2024-c40-and-xc40-recharge-become-first-rear-wheel-drive-volvos-in-america-in-25-years/

generations.name: 2024 RWD update
generations.notes: New Single Motor Extended Range RWD on an 82 kWh gross (~79 usable) pack, DC up to 200 kW; Twin Motor keeps 78 kWh / 150 kW (NRCan and EPA both list "C40 Recharge" single and "Twin" for 2024). Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://www.carscoops.com/2023/05/2024-c40-and-xc40-recharge-become-first-rear-wheel-drive-volvos-in-america-in-25-years/ ; https://www.cars.com/articles/2024-volvo-c40-recharge-xc40-recharge-get-more-range-new-powertrains-465971

generations.name: EC40
generations.notes: Renamed EC40 for MY2025 (with the XC40 Recharge becoming EX40). Twin Motor moves to the 82 kWh pack; DC up to about 200-205 kW on both (same sources and caveats as volvo/ex40's ex40 generation). Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://insideevs.com/news/748105/2025-volvo-ex40-rename-xc40-recharge/ ; https://www.motorauthority.com/news/1145564_2025-volvo-ex40-price
